release_notes: Build 117 makes project folders permanent: changing a project between In Progress, Scheduled, Published or other statuses now updates the database only and never moves the project directory.
New projects now receive a stable ID-based folder such as 000184-Space Quiz, so their filesystem location no longer depends on workflow status.
Existing projects keep their current folder exactly where it is; no migration, rename or bulk folder move is performed by this update.
Regression tests cover both new stable folders and legacy status-based folders to prevent future status changes from breaking project paths.
Build 116 Needs You stability improvements and Build 115 SQLite project protection remain included unchanged.
